entities.name: Library Management System
entities.description: Provides self-service portals, circulation management, and cataloguing for public and academic libraries with EU-only data residency and strict search SLAs.

entities.name: Library Patrons & Staff
entities.description: Actors interacting via HTTPS/TLS to use self-service portals, circulation management, and cataloguing.

entities.name: Third-Party Digital Content Providers
entities.description: External system integrated via REST APIs for digital content.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External system for processing fines and fees securely.

entities.name: Notification Service
entities.description: External system for patron alerts via Webhooks/SMTP.

entities.name: EU-edge Reverse Proxy
entities.description: Edge-caching and CDN layer with WAF and rate limiting deployed on EU-Hosted Cloud Infrastructure.

interfaces.description: Interacts via HTTPS/TLS 1.3, OIDC/OAuth2 authentication (with MFA for staff).
Accesses self-service portals, circulation management, and cataloguing.
Integrates via REST APIs with circuit breakers and fallback caching.
Processes secure financial transactions for fines and fees.
Sends patron alerts using cryptographic message signing.

naming_conventions: External systems are named using descriptive functional titles like '<Name> Service' or '<Name> Gateway'
System names are Capitalized Full Names representing the entire product scope
